sentences.text: The observations in paragraph No. 6 of the aforesaid order dated 13th August, 2023 record that the question as to whether the particular drug that led to the adverse drug reaction originated from the applicant is a matter for investigation.
Indeed, that would be a matter for adjudication at the trial.
In the FIR, as many as 12 persons/entities, who allegedly manufactured, distributed or otherwise handled the drug have been implicated as accused.
7. In the backdrop of the nature of the accusation, the reasons Vishal Parekar

which weighed this Court in granting the interim bail to the applicants and the core question which would arise for adjudication at the trial, further custodial interrogation of the applicants does not seem warranted.
8. I am, therefore, inclined to make the orders of interim bail absolute.
Hence, the following order.
ORDER 1] The order of interim bail in ABA No. 343 of 2023 dated 13 th March, 2023 is made absolute on the terms and conditions incorporated therein.
2] The order of interim bail in ABA No. 2320 of 2023 dated 30th August, 2023 is made absolute on the terms and conditions incorporated therein.
3] The applicants shall regularly attend the proceedings before the jurisdictional Court.
